promises.label: Full year revenue target
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.quote: So, in terms of revenue, I think last quarter is going to be a busy quarter for us, and including the last quarter for FY '26, we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum and mainly driven by EMS revenues.

promises.label: FY28 revenue target
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
promises.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that because for us, from our bare board, from our OSAT, additional buildings are going to take place.

promises.label: OSAT business revenue potential
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business. Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

promises.label: PC Board business revenue potential
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business. Now beyond just fine-tuning at this point in time, when they start delivering, then we can probably fine -tune these when we start managing the order book, et cetera.

promises.label: Net working capital days target
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days. Last year, it was 85 days. We have not made significant improvements, because we have to contend with our delivery schedule for customers and be ready to deliver sometimes a little more inefficiently.

promises.label: Consolidated operating cash flow
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.quote: So this year, you can expect at consol level, definitely a significant positive operating cash flow.
